messages.title: vgmu 2.0.2: Artwork cards and improved XMB
messages.body: Tap any gallery image to open it in a card, then tap again to zoom in full screen. Hold anything on Home to queue it, and Console's XMB background now moves. Tap to read more.

messages.title: vgmu 2.0.1: Tap a lyric to jump there
messages.body: Tap any synced lyric line to skip the song to it. Game artwork adds logos and an optional Large artwork setting, and Liked Tracks no longer reshuffles when tracks download. Tap to read more.

messages.title: Welcome to vgmu 2.0
messages.body: Internet Archive search, landscape mode, Theater, synced lyrics, eight new languages, controller support on Android, and this Inbox. Tap to read the full post.
